Push is the symmetric inverse: POST to /git-receive-pack with a dulwich-written pack. cfg_lever_scope.note: The mrustc --cfg bypass (cfg.cpp checks CLI --cfg before the hardcoded callback) is NOT a universal key — proven by the sweep. It unlocks exactly ONE real thing: threads/atomics (target_feature=atomics, the only target_feature with real std gates). panic= has no cfg gates; simd128 has no std cfg gates (it is a clang -msimd128 autovec win, not cfg). NOT-cfg-fixable (confirmed empirically): edition-2024 (PARSER ceiling — gen blocks crash mrustc in Parse_Expr2), proc-macros (separate mechanism), ~40 llvm.wasm.* SIMD intrinsics (codegen_c.cpp aborts on Extern LLVM — i8x16_bitmask/swizzle/narrow/relaxed_* etc.; autovec is the mitigation). Stop hoping --cfg reaches these.
